benchmarks.title: Hardware benchmarks
benchmarks.intro: Pick a GPU and see what it costs to run — and how long until it pays for itself.
benchmarks.priceNote: Prices are editable — enter what you actually pay for better numbers.
benchmarks.method1: Daily output = speed × hours you run.
benchmarks.method2: Power cost = watts × hours × electricity price.
benchmarks.method3: Cost per day = electricity + hardware spread over its life.
benchmarks.method4: Payback days = rig price ÷ money saved per day.
benchmarks.dualNote: Dual cards need case room and enough power supply.
